extension.description: Workspace-scoped TokenLighten setup, savings, and logs for Copilot, Codex, and Claude Code
command.usage.show: TokenLighten: Show This Workspace's Usage and Savings
command.logs.export: TokenLighten: Export This Workspace's Usage Logs
command.uninstallMachine: TokenLighten: Uninstall TokenLighten from This Machine
command.copilotGuide.applyToWorkspaceFil: TokenLighten: Apply Copilot guide to workspace file
config.language: Display language for all TokenLighten extension UI.
config.language.auto: Automatic (use the VS Code display language)
config.autoUpdate.enabled: Automatically download and install newer TokenLighten VSIX releases when update checks are enabled. Disable to receive update notifications only.
config.updateCheck.enabled: Check GitHub Releases for a newer TokenLighten VSIX at startup and every six hours. Disabling this also stops automatic updates.
config.confirmResetOnUpdate: After TokenLighten is updated to a newer version (automatically or manually), ask whether to reset your TokenLighten user settings to their default values when any of them differs from its default; closing the notification without answering asks again at the next startup. Workspace and folder settings are never changed.
